init_sequence.notes: After power-on or soft reset, the device starts in Standby mode and no measurements are performed.
Wait until SENSOR_RDY is set before starting measurements; datasheet gives up to 12 ms after start-up or soft reset.
Wait until COEF_RDY is set before reading calibration coefficients; datasheet gives up to 40 ms after start-up or soft reset.
Read Product and Revision ID to confirm the device is present and identify revision/product.
Soft reset by writing 1001 to SOFT_RST; FIFO_FLUSH may also be written to clear FIFO.

read_sequence.notes: Read pressure measurement as 3 bytes, MSB first, from PSR_B2 through PSR_B0.
Read temperature measurement as 3 bytes, MSB first, from TMP_B2 through TMP_B0.
Read calibration coefficients from 0x10 through 0x21 using auto-increment.
Poll measurement status bits such as COEF_RDY, SENSOR_RDY, TMP_RDY, and PRS_RDY.
Read interrupt status; register is cleared on read.
Read FIFO status bits FIFO_FULL and FIFO_EMPTY.
